name: AR_TRX_SUMMARY_HIST
description: This table stores the history of all the modifications performed on different transactions, which would affect the data in the summary tables. The history data in this table is used by the subscriptions of the various receivables business events, raised during the Receivables business flows, to update the summary table.

columns.name: HISTORY_ID
columns.description: History Record Identifier

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: Identifies the transaction.

columns.name: CASH_RECEIPT_ID
columns.description: Identifies the payment.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the payment schedule of the transaction.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the previous history record of the current transaction.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: Due date of the transaction installment.

columns.name: AMOUNT_IN_DISPUTE
columns.description: Amount in dispute against the installment of the transaction.

columns.name: AMOUNT_DUE_ORIGINAL
columns.description: Amount due original on the transaction.

columns.name: AMOUNT_ADJUSTED
columns.description: Amount adjusted on the installment.

columns.name: COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether processing of the current record is complete. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Customer account identifier.

columns.name: SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Site use identifier.

columns.name: AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING
columns.description: Current amount due remaining.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for the currency of the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_DATE
columns.description: Transaction Date

columns.name: EVENT_NAME
columns.description: Business event associated with the current record.

columns.name: INSTALLMENTS
columns.description: Number of installments of the current transaction.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
